description: This file defines the class 'LoanRescheduleModelRepaymentPeriod', which models a loan repayment period within the loan rescheduling domain. It includes attributes like period number, dates, various monetary dues, and whether the period is new or not. The class provides constructors, factory method, data conversion, accessor methods, and update methods related to a loan repayment period.

classes.name: LoanRescheduleModelRepaymentPeriod
classes.description: Immutable class representing a loan repayment period with details such as dates, amounts, and status.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of LoanRescheduleModelRepaymentPeriod with provided data.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the object to LoanSchedulePeriodData for scheduling purposes.

methods.name: periodFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the period.

methods.name: periodDueDate
methods.description: Returns the due date for the period.

methods.name: principalDue
methods.description: Returns the principal due as BigDecimal.

methods.name: interestDue
methods.description: Returns the interest due as BigDecimal.

methods.name: feeChargesDue
methods.description: Returns fee charges due as BigDecimal.

methods.name: penaltyChargesDue
methods.description: Returns penalty charges due as BigDecimal.

methods.name: isNew
methods.description: Indicates if this is a new period.
